title: In-client fault-handling report
description: The final answer a Host session gives after the Router SKILL has planned a task while the Router MCP server was unavailable, denied, or failing. Route fields follow the Behavior contract; the two runtime fields report what the session observed, not what it intended.

runtime_binding.description: bundled-local-r0 only when the Router MCP server answered plan_work in this session; skill-only-fallback when the route came from the SKILL instructions alone.

mcp_outcome.description: What happened to the Router's plan_work call in this session: succeeded, unavailable (no Router MCP tools were offered), denied (the Host refused the call), or failed (the call ran and returned an error).
